headline: The 5 best Atarim alternatives for agencies (2026)

superflowLinks.label: How the AI review agents work

entries.name: SureFeedback
entries.bestFor: WordPress agencies that want to self-host and own the data.
entries.standout: one flat license, self-hosted, unlimited projects, sites, and users; GPL and full white label.
entries.limits: A person finds every issue by hand. No AI, no memory concept, projects start blank. No native two-way sync with Jira, Trello, or Asana, automation runs through Zapier or Make. Pricing: Starter $99, Professional $139, Business $169, renews $119, $159, $199 per year (July 2026).
entries.vsAnchor: Human-found only, no AI review layer like Atarim's InnerCircle. SureFeedback self-hosts and you own the data outright; Atarim is a hosted SaaS with a native WordPress plugin of its own.

entries.name: BugHerd
entries.bestFor: agencies that want feedback pinned right on the live page, on a budget.
entries.standout: element pins with browser, OS, and screen size attached; built-in kanban; free guest links.
entries.limits: A person finds every issue. No AI, no memory concept, each project starts blank. A formal approval flow: not yet verified. Pricing: Standard $50, Studio $80, Premium $150 per month, plus $8 per member (July 2026).
entries.vsAnchor: Human-found only, no AI review layer like Atarim's InnerCircle. Both grant free guests; only Atarim's plugin natively reviews inside WP Admin on staging and login-protected sites.

entries.name: Pastel
entries.bestFor: fast markup rounds with clients, zero install.
entries.standout: no code snippet or extension; the canvas stays live through a proxy; a Finish Review approval step on every plan, including Free.
entries.limits: A person finds every issue, no AI review layer. No memory concept, canvases start blank and approvals reset on each new version. PM-tool exports gated to the Team plan, $119 per month. Pricing: Free $0, Pro $35, Team $119, Enterprise $450 per month (July 2026).
entries.vsAnchor: Reviews the site through Pastel's proxy, not in place on the page the way Atarim's WordPress plugin does. Human-found only, no AI review layer like Atarim's InnerCircle.

entries.name: Ruttl
entries.bestFor: the closest look-alike, with live-page visual edits on a budget.
entries.standout: edit mode changes text, images, layout, and HTML or CSS on the live page; built-in kanban; screen-recorded video comments.
entries.limits: A person finds every issue. Ruttl AI is scoped to comment sentiment and performance suggestions; accessibility, SEO, and codebase audit are marked Coming soon. No memory concept found. Pricing: Basic free, Pro $18 per user per month, Business and Enterprise custom (July 2026).
entries.vsAnchor: Ruttl's AI sorts sentiment and performance, not page issues, a person still finds every mistake. Atarim's InnerCircle actually scans the page for design, UX, SEO, copy, accessibility, and QA.

stayHeading: The sixth option: stay on Atarim
stayBody: Six InnerCircle AI agents review any page for design, UX, SEO, copy, accessibility, and QA issues in seconds, with full page context. A native WordPress plugin reviews the front end and WP Admin on live, staging, and login-protected sites, alongside review by URL or Chrome extension on any site. Clients and guests are unlimited and free on every plan. Global, Project, and User context layers keep brand standards and workflows in memory across reviews (verified July 2026).
stayLine: If your work is WordPress-heavy agency delivery, and you want an AI review team plus visual client feedback and page approvals in one place, Atarim is a strong fit. Stay.

faq.question: Which is the best Atarim alternative?
faq.answer: Depends which criterion fails you. Atarim already runs an AI review team; if the gap is running that check on every change instead of on demand, plus a recorded team-then-client sign-off, Superflow is the fit.

faq.question: Is Superflow just Atarim with AI?
faq.answer: No. Atarim already has AI, six agents that scan a page on demand. Superflow's agents run from your checklist on every site change and pin findings as comments before a person looks.

faq.question: Can clients comment without an account?
faq.answer: Yes, on both. Atarim's clients use Guest Mode or a shared link. In Superflow the client's yes is a recorded approval, not a comment.

faq.question: What does switching cost?
faq.answer: An afternoon. One snippet, or one click on Webflow, WordPress, GTM. Open projects finish where they are.
